recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a stale built example caused by the seed's original application being superseded by later operation-alignment decisions; no further core change is recommended for FHIR-34112.
issue_request: FHIR-34112 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification CQI change request for R6. It originally asked to clarify the Measure/$collect-data measure input for type-level versus instance invocation, and the final resolution broadened that to align base $collect-data with DEQM, including measure input/output handling and examples.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#3440 and commit 70da68c569ba2bfa3e43bf9869e844059b0f4841 applied FHIR-34112 by adding DEQM-style measureId, measureIdentifier, measureUrl, measureResource, and measure inputs, allowing instance invocation, and adding request examples using those parameters.
additional_context: Later applied and already-reconciled work changed the current operation signature: FHIR-51066 moved Measure/$collect-data to a type-level operation with required repeatable measureUrl, FHIR-55967 removed organization-style inputs in favor of reporter/reporterResource alignment, and FHIR-40422 updated subject/subjectGroup handling. FHIR-49856 also records the related R6/DEQM simplified single canonical URL pattern. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch or outside FHIR-core, so they were used only as context.
reconciliation: Changed source/measure/$collect-data-request.txt to use only parameters declared by the current OperationDefinition: measureUrl for measure selection, plus current subject/subjectGroup, reporter, location, period, and lastReceivedOn parameters. No OperationDefinition source change was made because the current signature reflects later applied decisions.
source_changes: source/measure/$collect-data-request.txt: replaced stale measureId, measureIdentifier, organization, and practitioner query examples with examples using current measureUrl, reporter, and location parameters.
